summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtins feature. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) enumeration with all eleven members, values, and comments per the spec. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint config (treated as no variant tags); added public ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean. It reads FIPS and DualStack only through the bridge's lookups, reuses the existing STS and S3 predicates, and applies the specified defaults. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (21 tests, derived from unittest.TestCase). Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 58 passed; test_regions.py and test_client.py suites 356 passed. Nothing committed. One pre-existing 82-column line in args.py (line 315) was left unchanged because it predates this work.
